purpose: return a depth/entry bounded directory tree for an authorized root.

source.source_text: Purpose: return a depth/entry bounded directory tree for an authorized root. Input: path:string, depth?:0..8, max_entries?:1..5000. Output: sanitized tree with truncation. Contract: L1 read_only; scope mac.files.read; target path; timeout 10000ms; cap 512KiB; network none; filesystem read_allowed_roots; deny-zone filtering mandatory; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 2 planned.
